rules: Use the cream background on every slide.
Use cobalt only for eyebrows, numerals, chart fills, progress, accent rules, and CTA elements.
Do not set main headlines in cobalt.
Use soft cobalt-tinted cards with translucent cobalt borders.
Do not add a second accent color for categories.
Use no drop shadows on content cards.
Every content slide should carry an eyebrow/tag header rhythm unless the frame is cover, quote, or closing.

frames.purpose: Opening title slide with left-aligned title, short subtitle, meta line, cobalt accent rule, and diagonal right-side panel.
Table of contents using a two-column agenda grid.
Three large metric cards plus supporting context.
Dense 3-column or 2-row stat grid for data overview.
Narrative split slide with body on one side and detail blocks or highlighted callout on the other.
Horizontal ranking/bar chart with cobalt fills and grey tracks.
Large quote or thesis slide, used sparingly for a major insight.
Four-step horizontal process/timeline with cobalt numbered circles.
Detail analysis page with multi-block explanations.
Final thanks and optional CTA/contact information.

known_gaps: The current PPTX uses screenshot backgrounds, so decorative elements and baked text in the background are not directly editable.
Editable text boxes are overlaid from DOM text-node coordinates, but PowerPoint font availability may differ from browser-rendered web fonts.
Generated production decks should render backgrounds from generated content or hide baked text before overlaying visible editable text.
